run_onnx_export: run the onnx_export script to export a PyTorch model to ONNX format with a specified output file
export_model_with_custom_opset: export a geffnet model to ONNX using a custom opset version via the --opset flag
export_model_with_dynamic_size: export a model with dynamic input width and height using the --dynamic-size flag
export_model_with_caffe2_compatibility: export a model with --keep-init and --aten-fallback flags for Caffe2 backend compatibility
validate_exported_onnx_model: validate an exported ONNX model by loading and checking it with onnx.checker.check_model
